content.snl: thm-hyp(list-partial(Type.judge(@A, Analysis.Seq), Type.judge(list-partial(@L, @M), Real), Analysis.seqLim(A, L), Analysis.seqLim(A, M)), Eq(L, M))
content.markdown: If a sequence tends to both `L` and `M` then `L = M`, and the same holds for each of the seven function-limit notions. Uniqueness is what licenses the value forms of the previous subsection: without it there would be no well-defined element to name.
